messages:
maya: FYI — I'm proposing a new rollout primitive for runtime config: "phased activation" with quorum checks + telemetry gates. Goal: safer gradual flips that can auto-throttle/rollback based on live signals. Need API shape + Console UX input.

ben: high-level question — how is this different from our existing 'percent rollout' flag? is this mostly the telemetry gating and quorum semantics?

maya: yep. percent rollouts exist, but we currently have no good way to say "only advance to next percent if these metrics stayed stable for N minutes" or "require X successful health samples from the new cohort before increasing". also want a dry-run/simulate mode that shows estimated cost impact in the Console.

carmen: Console UX thoughts: show a compact timeline for the rollout with a live pass/fail badge for each telemetry gate, and a small delta column that shows estimated QPS/token cost change if the rollout advances. Also an explicit "simulate" toggle that runs the same routing rules but doesn't affect production routing.

lee: two warnings: 1) concurrent config updates — if someone edits the percent while automation tries to advance it, we need optimistic locking or check-and-set. 2) KV cache and batching effects: sudden increase for a cohort might change batching behavior and skew metrics. We should add pre-advance stabilization window.

sam: for API contract, proposal sketch:

```json
{
  "flag": "route_by_cost_v2",
  "strategy": "phased",
  "phases": [
    {"percent": 5,  "min_success_samples": 50, "stabilize_secs": 300},
    {"percent": 25, "min_success_samples": 200, "stabilize_secs": 600}
  ],
  "telemetry_gates": [
    {"id": "tg-latency", "metric": "p95_latency_ms", "threshold": 400, "direction": "lte"},
    {"id": "tg-errors",  "metric": "error_rate",    "threshold": 0.01,  "direction": "lte"}
  ],
  "dry_run": true,
  "fail_mode": "fail-closed"  
}
```

maya: basic semantics: automation evaluates telemetry_gates in the target cohort window; if gates pass and min_success_samples met + stabilize window expired, advance to next phase. If gates fail, hold/rollback. dry_run should simulate routing logic and produce a report only.

ben: for endpoints, I like PATCH /runtime/configs/:id/rollout with body above. For dry-run, accept header `X-Dry-Run: true` so CLI/cURL can simulate quickly.

carmen: UX nit: when flag has `fail_mode=fail-closed` show a red pill in Console and an override button visible only to owners/sre with an audit modal. Also a small inline graph of the gate metrics for the last 30m.

lee: agree on optimistic locking. also propose we include `last_expected_state` and `controller_id` in updates so automation can detect drift and surface conflicts in the UI.

sam: migration/backcompat: existing percent-only flags should map to a single-phase phased strategy. we should accept both shapes in the API for a transition period and emit a migration warning in Console.

deploy-bot: CI -> rollout-tests pipeline passed: https://ci.internal/runner/1092 :white_check_mark:

maya: ops question — what about multi-region routing? if cohorts live in different regions with different model variants, telemetry merges are tricky. proposal: gates are evaluated per-region and advancement is per-region unless `global_coordinator=true` is set.

ben: also add a safety budget: max_total_impact_pct that prevents automation from ever exceeding a configured delta on cost/latency across the whole fleet. e.g., "max_total_impact_pct": 3

carmen: UX: Console should let PMs preview per-customer impact (estimated token cost delta) for a given cohort before starting rollout.

lee: runtime side: we'll need a small API on the serving nodes to report cohort-level health samples (sampled counts, p95, error counts) with labels so the controller can evaluate gates. sampling rate should be configurable.

sam: edge-case: if telemetry pipeline lags, we risk false failures. controller should support a "stale_data_tolerance" and either pause advancement or enlarge stabilize window when data sources are delayed.

ops-bot: Note: we already have an internal alert rule `telemetry_ingest_lag > 60s` that should be checked before any auto-advances are allowed.

maya: decision proposals to vote on:
1) API shape above with `phases` + `telemetry_gates` + `dry_run` — consensus? 2) default `fail_mode=fail-closed` (safer) 3) Console shows simulate toggle + per-region toggle + estimated cost delta column.

ben: 1) yes, matches needs. 2) prefer `fail-closed` for customer-facing flags, but allow per-flag override. 3) yup.

carmen: +1 on UX proposals.

lee: +1 for locking and per-region evaluations. small ask: add a `controller_backoff_policy` field so controller doesn't hammer retries.

sam: I'll own API PR + migration plan. plan to deprecate old shape after 8 weeks. I'll post a draft spec tomorrow.

maya: action items:
- sam: PR + migration plan (due: 3 business days)
- lee: propose node telemetry sample contract (due: 5 business days)
- carmen: Console mockups for simulate + per-region preview (due: 4 business days)
- ben: add endpoint/CLI ergonomics + header conventions (help review sam's PR)

maya: thanks all — tagging @here to make sure SRE/telemetry folks know this will touch ingest and controller logic. :eyes!
